author: Rinehart

dengaima wrote: Ryan, I got into same trade but out already. Where is your tp?

Dengaima

On GBPUSD price has hit the level I had marked for my next target. I
have taken half profit. I will now leave the remainder to see if we can
 get all the way down to my final TP. I have also removed the 2nd QM
pending order I had. I still feel that area can give a reaction, but I
would prefer to see some kind of compelling price action again such as a
 BSZ, CP to the level or 3 Drive.

With large amounts of the trade taken as profit and the remainder at BE
with plenty of room to breathe, I can completely ignore the trade for a
while. This is 100% necessary to have a chance to catch the big runner.
 I don't want to think about the position because IT can shake me out
of it by convincing me they are going the other way.

Sorry sev87, I didn't notice your question.

You are correct that there was not an engulf. There were a few factors
that got me into the trade. It was something of a Cancan. I had an
engulf on EURUSD showing lower prices. I have an engulf on AUDUSD
showing higher prices, which I showed both of these trades. We had
broken the rising wedge's trendline support which is not RTM but true
nonetheless. Price had rejected moving higher twice right before my
entry.
